licence.notes: Card: CC BY-NC 4.0. Some training datasets allow only non-commercial or research use, so the author released it for non-commercial use. Redistribution only under CC BY-NC terms with attribution.

jev_distillation.evidence: Training data lists "community typed-decision sets" without naming them. Footer: "it was not trained on Jev outputs." The Jev API appears only as a benchmark row ("Jev 1.13.0 (TypeSafe AI, API) | closed").
jev_distillation.display_note: The author has not published where the training data came from. We found no statement or evidence that it was distilled from Jev outputs.

installer_policy.reason: Not in the union of the open JevBench board's top 10 by Capability Score and top 10 by Composite Score (board v1.7.43, 2026-10-10), so the one-command installer does not support it. Local install is available on request.
installer_policy.previous_reason: The model licence (cc-by-nc-4.0) allows non-commercial use only. The author has not published where the training data came from. We found no statement or evidence that it was distilled from Jev outputs.

readout.notes: llm2jev reads option-label logits from vLLM or SGLang token logprobs; vLLM needs --max-logprobs 256 and --return-tokens-as-token-ids. Not plain OpenAI completions; llama.cpp and MLX not verified.
readout.portable_notes: Author llm2jev --backend hf uses plain transformers; CPU fallback is available with CUDA hidden and device_map auto. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tic-top/llm2jev/1b2521c73cde94129a7cc9c2e48a2ac329572073/llm2jev/backends.py L147: def __init__(self, model, device=None, dtype="bfloat16", **_):; L158: self.model = cls.from_pretrained(model, dtype=getattr(torch, dtype), device_map=device or "auto").eval(). CLI __main__.py L79 instantiates that backend without a device override. BF16 CPU variant added, unmeasured. No explicit MPS selection or author Mac recipe at the pinned revision, so no MPS variant added. HF is a serial correctness reference, not the GPU serving benchmark. vLLM logprob_token_ids and SGLang token_ids_logprob mean backend_agnostic=false for the network shims. Noncommercial restriction retained.

variants.notes: Weights 9.1 GB BF16; min 12 / recommended 16 GB (ROSTER estimate ~11 GB). The card's assets/*.gif are excluded. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 9.079 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 16 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more. Installer recipe is source-derived and unverified; this executable runtime was not benchmarked. See catalog/IMAGE-RECIPES-V2.md for modifications and dependency provenance.
